note: World units and identifiers shared by C++ and GDScript (FND-07). Material and entity-kind values are saved: append only, never reuse or renumber. Generated into native/src/core/generated/world_ids.h and shared/ids/world_ids.gd by tools/build/gen_ids.gd.

constant_notes.SHAFT_CENTRE_X2: The shaft centre in doubled tile units: (10.0, 10.0), the middle of cell (0,0). It must stay on the half-tile grid.
constant_notes.TILE_STATE_OPEN: Bit 0 of a tile's state byte: open, for STEEL gates and WOODEN_DOOR air doors. Other bits are GEN-01's.

materials.name: FLOOR
materials.note: Open tile; never an illusion source

materials.name: ROCK
materials.note: Shares every rule with COAL; the Tapper lives in it

materials.name: BRICK
materials.note: The Tapper cannot enter, strike through or speak from it; voice never crosses it

materials.name: STEEL
materials.note: A gate: shut stops voice and takes 12 np; open is floor

materials.name: WOODEN_DOOR
materials.note: An air door: shut blocks light and voice and takes 12 np; open is floor. Bumps as [timber] (GEN-01, Proposed)

entity_kinds.name: MINER
entity_kinds.note: Player or Hired Hand; a fallen miner stays the same entity

entity_kinds.name: TAPPER_ARM
entity_kinds.note: The Tapper's arm out of a wall face, only in WindUp, Pin and ReStrike: the only part of it ever seen or hit
